description: Arbre spécialisé pour fichiers et dossiers.

methods.name: beginRenamePath(path: string): void
methods.description: Starts inline renaming for the tree item matching path; does nothing for an empty or missing path.

methods.name: collapseAll(): void
methods.description: Collapses every directory in the displayed tree; has no effect before the internal tree is created.

methods.name: expandAll(): void
methods.description: Expands every directory in the displayed tree; has no effect before the internal tree is created.

methods.name: getNodes(): TpFileTreeNode[]
methods.description: Returns a detached, recursively sorted copy of the root nodes, with directories before files.

methods.name: setActivePath(path: string | null): void
methods.description: Sets the active-file path; null clears the active marker without changing selection.

methods.name: setDirtyPaths(paths: readonly string[]): void
methods.description: Replaces the set of file paths marked as modified; an empty array removes every modified marker.

methods.name: setNodes(nodes: readonly TpFileTreeNode[]): void
methods.description: Replaces the root nodes with a recursively sorted copy while retaining selected, active, open and dirty paths.

methods.name: setOpenPaths(paths: readonly string[]): void
methods.description: Replaces the set of file paths marked as open; does not change the active or selected path.

methods.name: setSelectedPath(path: string | null): void
methods.description: Sets the highlighted selected path; null clears selection. Retains the active path and file states.

methods.name: setState(state: TpFileTreeState): void
methods.description: Replaces the displayed nodes and selected, active, open and dirty paths together; rerenders the tree and expands its directories.

events.name: tp-file-tree-active
events.description: Emitted when selecting a file makes it active; path identifies the file. Selecting an already active file can emit it again.

events.name: tp-file-tree-add-request
events.description: Requests creation of a file or directory; path is the target path, or null for the root, and kind specifies the entry type. The consumer performs the creation.

events.name: tp-file-tree-clone-request
events.description: Requests duplication of the entry at path; the consumer performs the copy.

events.name: tp-file-tree-copy-request
events.description: Requests copying the selected path to the clipboard; the consumer performs the copy.

events.name: tp-file-tree-delete-request
events.description: Requests deletion of the entry at path; the consumer performs the deletion.

events.name: tp-file-tree-global-action
events.description: Emitted when a global context-menu action is chosen; actionId contains its identifier.

events.name: tp-file-tree-move-request
events.description: Requests moving sourcePath relative to destinationPath at position; a null destination denotes the root. The consumer performs the move.
events.detail: { sourcePath: string; destinationPath: string | null; position: "inside" | "before" | "after" }

events.name: tp-file-tree-open
events.description: Emitted when a file is selected for opening; path identifies the file. Selecting an already open file can emit it again.

events.name: tp-file-tree-rename-request
events.description: Requests renaming the entry at path to newName; the consumer performs the rename.

events.name: tp-file-tree-select
events.description: Emitted after a file or directory row is selected; path identifies the selected entry.

cssproperties.name: --tp-file-tree-active-color
cssproperties.description: Text color of the active file row.

cssproperties.name: --tp-file-tree-dirty-color
cssproperties.description: Color of the dot marking a file with unsaved changes.

cssproperties.name: --tp-file-tree-icon-size
cssproperties.description: Width and height of file and directory icons.

cssproperties.name: --tp-file-tree-open-color
cssproperties.description: Text color of rows whose paths are marked as open.

cssproperties.name: --tp-file-tree-selected-bg
cssproperties.description: Background color of the selected path row.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-icon
dependencies.summary: SVG icon component with inline, URL, and registry sources.

dependencies.name: tp-tree
dependencies.summary: Generic tree component for interactive hierarchical editing.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-file-tree>` element implements the <tp-icon name="file-tree" library="components" size="1.25em"></tp-icon> File Tree functionality: arbre spécialisé pour fichiers et dossiers.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Expand or collapse branches to inspect nested items. |
| Select | Select available links or entries to use the actions provided by the surrounding page. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
